description.value: Pidgin is an Asian-French fusion restaurant situated in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, blending the culinary traditions of two distinct food cultures into a single dining experience. It occupies a prominent spot on Carrall Street, a key corridor connecting downtown Vancouver to the seawall cycling network. The restaurant has garnered enough acclaim to announce a future location at Time Out Market Vancouver.
